input.free_text_description: This system is an user management platform that serves Admin, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for post, post, replies. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to interact with post functionality, so that I can accomplish my post-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with replies functionality, so that I can accomplish my replies-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with chat functionality, so that I can accomplish my chat-related tasks.
